s.n: Stovetop maple bacon brown butter popcorn
s.note: the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long
s.how: Fry 4 rashers of streaky bacon until very crisp, then crumble. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows, then pull it off straight away. Cook 60g butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in 2 tbsp maple syrup. Pour over the popcorn, toss with the bacon and a good pinch of flaky salt.

Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo and paprika. Simmer 16 cocktail franks in 100ml barbecue sauce with a spoon of grape jelly until sticky. Fill celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.

m.note: John's long hours at the hospital
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and set aside. Soften 250g mushrooms, stir in 250g long grain rice, 500ml stock, 150ml cream and thyme. Lay the chicken on top, cover and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

w.note: the doll John finally finds for Mia's collection
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites with 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter and pipe white. Add a tiny pink sugar rose.

d.how: Blend 1L mint choc chip ice cream with 400ml cold milk until thick. Pour into 4 glasses. For the grown-ups, blend in 30ml crème de menthe and 30ml crème de cacao per glass.
